paper.quote: Given the initial sparsity attribute, SparTA performs attribute propagation to infer the sparsity attributes of all other tensors in the deep learning model, according to the propagation rules (§3.2).

Given a node, if the TeSA of any input or output tensor of a node is updated (TeSAOf in Line 5), PropOneNode (Line 6) updates the TeSA of other tensors associated with this node, according to a certain propagation rule (as discussed later, the propagation could be bidirectional). The propagation repeats until no TeSA requires further update.
We implemented sparsity attribute propagation as a dedicated compilation pass over Rammer.
